title: ISC — New User Welcome (EN/AR)
description: Triggers when ISC fires a user.registered webhook. Sends a bilingual welcome email via Gmail, choosing EN or AR based on the lang field.

settings.note: Copy the generated Catch Hook URL and paste it into ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'user.registered'.
Ensures lang is always 'en' or 'ar'. Pass the output to the Filter step.

steps.name: Route to English email
steps.note: This path sends the English welcome email. Create a second Zap with the filter reversed for Arabic.

settings.subject: Welcome to I Supply Chain — {{1__data__name}}
settings.body:
🎉 Welcome to I Supply Chain

Dear {{1__data__name}},

settings.note: Connect your Gmail account. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN in the body.
Use the same Catch Hook URL as the English Zap.

setupSteps: 1. In Zapier, create a new Zap and choose 'Webhooks by Zapier' as the trigger with event 'Catch Hook'.
2. Copy the Catch Hook URL and register it in ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'user.registered'.
3. Add a Filter step: continue only if lang (Text) Does not exactly match 'ar' — this handles the English path.
4. Add a Gmail action. Connect your Gmail account and paste the English email HTML from this file.
5. Create a second Zap with the same webhook URL, filter for lang equals 'ar', and paste the Arabic email HTML.
6. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN in both email bodies.
